BL-1776 — provision-onboarding-telegram-channel.js keys a new swarm's fleet creds only by a swarm name the target declares - it wrote gpu-bargain-hunter's to ~/.swarmforge/fleet/gpu-bargain-hunter/ while the pack said config swarm_name GpuBargainHunter, so the front desk found none (2026-09-26); before any other step it checks the name against the target's swarmforge.conf and pack confs and refuses an undeclared one, naming what the target does declare, with nothing written and no call to Telegram
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: Intake item 3 offered two fixes: onboarding writes swarm_name into the target before provisioning, or the provisioner reads it from the target instead of taking a free argument. This ticket takes a middle path: the argument stays (the tutorial and callers keep working) but must be a name the target…
BL-1776 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1776" (or "reject BL-1776 <reason>") to act.
